Despite their large size, '''giant deer''' are usually rather harmless, unless a dwarf ends up getting them cornered. They can be [[tame]]d, and have a decent pet value of 500 like most giant animals, but they need a large pasture to survive, and won't be useful for fortress defense.

[[File:giant_deer2.jpg|thumb|center|300px|Most likely bigger in the game.]]
